grammar.summary: 本课讲述老妇人发现公寓遭窃的经过，集中运用了过去完成时、被动语态与定语从句。课文用过去完成时强调「出门前已锁门」先于发现，用被动语态叙述遭窃与检查过程，用 who/that 引导定语从句修饰窃贼与锁。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某动作」已完成的动作。本课用 had gone...had left 强调帮手先走、自己后出门的时间先后，用 had shut them 强调出门前已锁门，与发现门开形成对比。

examples.en: she remembered that she had gone shopping after the home help had left and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks
examples.cn: 但突然记起来了，帮手是在她出去买东西之前走的，她还记得曾用了两把钥匙把大门锁上了。

examples.en: yet following her regular practice she had shut them before going out.
examples.cn: 而她记得在出门买东西前，她按老规矩是把房门一一锁上的。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: be + 过去分词构成被动语态，突出动作承受者。本课用 had been forced 表示门锁被撬，用 had either used skeleton keys or entered 表示窃贼进屋方式的推断，叙述客观。

examples.en: It was as clear as daylight then that burglars had forced an entry during her absence.
examples.cn: 事情很清楚，在她外出时，窃贼曾闯进家门。

examples.en: the constable checked that the front door locks had not been forced, thereby proving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony.
examples.cn: 警察经检查发现大门锁头并无撬过的迹象。由此可以证明，窍贼或者是用万能钥匙，或者是翻越阳台进来的。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 who/that 引导定语从句修饰先行词并补充信息。本课用 who might still be lurking 修饰 intruders（可能仍潜藏的入侵者），用 that 修饰 bundle（装有珠宝的包袱），使描述具体。

examples.en: she was ready to set off with the porter's assistance to search for nay intruders who might still be lurking in her flat.
examples.cn: 此刻老妇人也镇定了下来，准备在看门人的协助下搜寻可能仍躲藏在她房里的窍贼。

examples.en: the inspector found a dirty red bundle that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers.
examples.cn: 巡官没有发现指纹，却发现了一个装有珠宝的、肮脏的红包袱。老妇人说那不是她的。

exercises.q: she remembered that she had gone shopping after the home help ______ left and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks.
the constable checked that the front door locks ______ not been forced, thereby proving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony.
she was ready to set off with the porter's assistance to search for nay intruders ______ might still be lurking in her flat.
用过去完成时填空：yet following her regular practice she ______ (shut) them before going out.
课文中 it might be more prudent to have someone with her 中 prudent 的含义最接近？
